<h2 class="content-label" data-i18n="detail.record">Record</h2>
<div class="prose-slot highlight-prose">
<p data-i18n="symposiumDetail.record.copy">From 15 to 19 December 2025, I attended the 6th Ringberg Symposium on Giant Virus Biology at Ringberg Castle near Tegernsee, Germany. On 15 December, I gave an oral presentation on a computational framework for detecting the dsDNA viral landscape in eukaryotic genomes.</p>
<p data-i18n="symposiumDetail.context.copy">The presentation was co-authored with Lingjie Meng, Ruixuan Zhang, Morgan Gaïa, and Hiroyuki Ogata. Lingjie Meng and Ruixuan Zhang from the Ogata Lab also gave oral presentations at the meeting.</p>
